purpose: Training-gap fill for Herblore / Prayer / Summoning production: region-tagged unlock methods, high-tier bone and herb supply, and Summoning tertiary/charm routes that matter under no-trading League constraints. Focus is supply geography and missing method rows rather than re-documenting powder/cleansing/vyre/chaos XP tables already in training-high-value.json.
verification_notes: Steel ingots from celestial dragons: CONFIRMED. Wiki drop table lists Steel ingot x8 (noted) at 8/136. Location: Dragontooth Island resource dungeon after One of a Kind; League region badge is Morytania.
Water talismans from celestial dragons: CONFIRMED. Water talisman x2 (noted) at 6/136 on the same table. Also many other combat/boss sources by region (see supply_routes).

Scroll of cleansing is a Daemonheim Rewards purchase (20k Dungeoneering tokens), not a Wilderness drop. Region pressure is Forinthry because Daemonheim sits on the Wilderness/Forinthry peninsula in the current Equilibrium region model.
Powder of burials is ground from speedy whirligig shells at Het's Oasis (Desert). The burial buff itself can be used anywhere; Desert is the self-sufficient powder source.
Charming moths remain a Forinthry Hunter route that also dumps Summoning charms; see training-methods.json Hunter row for XP rates.

methods.method: Flash Powder Factory — botanist's and factory outfits
methods.location: Rogues' Den under the Pick and Lute, Taverley
methods.level_range: 50 Herblore; 75 Thieving and Agility to access the factory
methods.effect: Botanist's outfit: up to 6% Herblore XP (1% per piece + 1% set). Factory outfit three-piece effect: 10% chance to make a 4-dose potion instead of 3-dose; five-piece unfinished-potion XP bonus. Modified botanist's mask: 5% chance to create a duplicate potion (no extra XP).
methods.notes: Self-sufficient League path is Asgarnia only — do not assume Treasure Hunter. Optimized setups often mix factory pieces (dose economy) with botanist pieces (XP) rather than wearing one full set for every potion.

methods.location: Daemonheim Rewards shop (Marmaros); alternate seasonal Prifddinas Daemonheim Rewards shop is discontinued/seasonal
methods.effect: Permanent 12.5% chance to mix one tick faster and 10% chance to save a secondary ingredient (including clean herbs when making unfinished potions). Roughly 11.1% more potions from a fixed secondary stock over the long run.
methods.notes: Purchase geography is Daemonheim, mapped to Forinthry/Wilderness in Equilibrium. Effect is global after unlock. Does not save the first ingredient (vial/flask/base) and does not apply to herb tars or cups of tea.

methods.method: Morytania legs 4 — prayer renewal dose chance (while in Morytania)
methods.location: Old Man Ral, Meiyerditch (elite Morytania achievements)
methods.effect: While worn and making prayer renewals in Morytania: 20% chance to create a 4-dose prayer renewal instead of 3-dose. Stacks with botanist's amulet and factory outfit.

prayer_adjacent.vyre_cremation: 50% more Firemaking and Prayer XP when cremating vyre corpses (including Sunspear)
prayer_adjacent.ectofuntus_support: Unlimited slime-pit teleports; Robin converts 39 bone sets/day with free slime buckets

methods.notes: Primarily a Prayer multi-skill and Ectofuntus QoL reward; the Herblore-relevant piece is the in-region 4-dose prayer renewal chance. Not a general Herblore XP outfit.

methods.location: Ancient Zygomite elder / Herby Werby Reward Shop, Anachronia
methods.cost: 200 spirit points base; +200 for upgrade to 100 of each grimy herb
methods.effect: Stores 50 (upgrade 100) of each grimy herb. Auto-stores unnoted grimy herb pickups and most herb-patch harvests while carried. Works with upgraded Herbicide auto-collect into the bag.
methods.notes: League-critical inventory QoL for self-sufficient herb farming and boss herb drops. Reclaimable from the elder if lost; filled state is preserved on reclaim.

methods.location: Het's Oasis (speedy whirligigs / hollyhock baskets) → grind 15 speedy whirligig shells per powder
methods.effect: Scatter for 30 minutes: burying bones awards 350% of base Prayer XP (250% bonus). Stacks up to 1 hour. Does not work with ashes, ectoplasmator, cremation, gilded/chaos altar offerings, or Double XP Prayer rules matching gilded altars.
methods.throughput_reference: Wiki training table ~4,700 bones/hour; 5,000–5,800 with tight action-bar execution. Example base XP/h with powder: dragon ~1.18m, dragonkin ~2.63m, dinosaur ~2.80m, frost dragon ~2.96m.
methods.notes: Desert is required for self-sufficient powder production, not for where bones are buried. Dragon Rider amulet cancels powder. Already in training-high-value.json; retained here as the Desert production dependency row.

methods.effect: 9,800 Prayer XP per uninterrupted crystal (11,760 during Hefin Voice of Seren). Shop restocks ~1/10s up to 30 at 110k each. Full-crystal route ~284k–341k XP/h; restart-spam initial XP is much higher XP/h at extreme coin cost.
methods.notes: Low-movement Tirannwn Prayer sink. Tirannwn quiver 3/4 auto-continues next crystal. Already summarised in training-high-value.json; kept as region production row for crystal shop access.

methods.effect: Sunspear cremates vyre corpses for Prayer + Firemaking (and combat) XP. Morytania legs 4 worn: +50% Firemaking and Prayer XP from cremating vyre corpses.
methods.throughput_reference: Wiki guide ~400k Prayer XP/h with legs 4, ~266k without; also large combat/constitution/firemaking side XP.
methods.notes: Already in training-high-value.json. Aura-sustain advice on that guide is obsolete after 2026 Aura Overhaul; method geography is unchanged.

methods.throughput_reference: About 1,600 bones/hour before achievement conveniences; ~3.5× base bone XP (elite Wilderness achievements improve reliability).
methods.notes: Forinthry Prayer sink that consumes banked bones without Desert powder. PvP risk remains.

methods.effect: Barehanded moth catching produces large volumes of gold/green charms (wiki obtaining-charms guide: high gold/green output; training-methods.json cites ~360 Summoning charms/hour near 99 alongside Hunter XP).
methods.notes: Link to existing Hunter training-methods.json row. Ignore legacy Demonic Skull XP bonus (removed July 2026 mid-game rebalance). Primary League value is simultaneous Hunter XP and charm banking under no trade.

methods.location: Vanligga Gastfrihet, Contraband Yak Produce, Jatizso
methods.level_range: 96 Summoning for pack yak pouches; Fremennik Isles access for shop
methods.effect: Yak-hide is the tertiary for pack yak pouches (crimson charm + 211 shards). Shop sells individual hides (35 stock @ 50 coins) and yak-hide packs (50 hides each; large weekly stock). Tax-paid quest path unlocks free trading; otherwise 5k fee.
methods.notes: Also available as always-drop from Neitiznot yaks and from Fremennik/spirit yaks on Player-Owned Farm, but the Jatizso shop is the bulk self-sufficient purchase route.

methods.method: Celestial dragons — steel ingots, water talismans, crimson charms
methods.location: Dragontooth Island resource dungeon (One of a Kind)
methods.effect: Steel ingots are a Summoning tertiary (steel titan line and related pouches). Water talismans are tertiaries for geyser titan and ice titan. Extremely high crimson charm rate makes this a dual tertiary+charm camp.
methods.notes: Claim 'celestial dragons drop steel ingots in Morytania' is correct. They also drop water talismans (not only steel). Requires One of a Kind for access.
